from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Tokens and tx list from previous step (recompute for safety)
phone_pwd=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='phone'][0]
phone_token=apis.phone.login(username='2254213734', password=phone_pwd)['access_token']
venmo_pwd=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
venmo_token=apis.venmo.login(username='jo-harr@gmail.com', password=venmo_pwd)['access_token']

phone_now=apis.phone.get_current_date_and_time()
current_date=datetime.strptime(phone_now['date'], '%A, %B %d, %Y').date()
start_date=current_date-timedelta(days=9)

# roommate emails
roommate_emails=set();
page_index=0; page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='', relationship='roommate', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    for c in page:
        if c.get('email'):
            roommate_emails.add(c['email'].lower())
    page_index+=1
    if page_index>50:
        break

# Fetch received txs in range
all_txs=[]; page_index=0; page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=venmo_token, direction='received', min_created_at=start_date.isoformat(), max_created_at=current_date.isoformat(), page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_txs.extend(page)
    page_index+=1
    if page_index>100:
        break

roommate_txs=[tx for tx in all_txs if (tx.get('sender') or {}).get('email','').lower() in roommate_emails]

# Unique tx ids
ids=[tx['transaction_id'] for tx in roommate_txs]
print('roommate_txs_ids', sorted(ids))

# For each tx, check existing comments and liked status
wanted_comment='Thank you so much!'

results=[]
for tx_id in sorted(ids):
    # gather comments with pagination
    comments=[]
    pi=0; pl=20
    while True:
        page_comments=apis.venmo.show_transaction_comments(transaction_id=tx_id, access_token=venmo_token, page_index=pi, page_limit=pl)
        if not page_comments:
            break
        comments.extend(page_comments)
        pi+=1
        if pi>50:
            break
    # check if wanted comment already exists exactly
    existing_any=any(c.get('comment')==wanted_comment for c in comments)
    # liked status from show_transactions result: find tx
    tx=[t for t in roommate_txs if t['transaction_id']==tx_id][0]
    liked=tx.get('liked')
    results.append((tx_id, tx.get('amount'), tx.get('created_at'), liked, existing_any, len(comments)))

for r in results:
    print('tx', r[0], 'amount', r[1], 'created_at', r[2], 'liked', r[3], 'has_wanted_comment', r[4], 'comment_count', r[5])
